title: Effective nuclear charge and shielding
basic_overview: Z_eff describes the net attraction experienced by an electron after shielding.

extra_info_content.short_trick: More Z with similar shielding → Z_eff ↑.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Select electron. 2. Estimate shielding. 3. Compare Z and S. 4. Explain radius/IE.
extra_info_content.factors: Penetration and poor d/f shielding matter.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
extra_info_content.exam_focus: Qualitative Slater-style reasoning and trend explanation.
